_comment: The experiment. Editing this file and re-running is how the routing strategy
gets revised — next quarter, or against models that do not exist yet.
Candidates per class are chosen to answer a specific question, not to sweep:
a sweep of 20 models x 8 cases x 3 samples is 480 calls and answers nothing
you could not get from 6. Each list below is 'the incumbent, plus the ones
that could plausibly beat it on THIS class's constraint'.
reflex/dialogue/digest want thinking OFF, so glm-5.3* and kimi-k2.7-code are
absent by construction — the catalog refuses them there, and the report says
so rather than pretending they were never considered.
judgeModel must be flagship and must not appear as a candidate: a model
grading its own homework is not a measurement. 2026-09-03: the first run
had qwen3.8-max as both, so on the assess class it went unjudged and then
WON the recommendation on token count alone — a winner with no quality
score at all. qwen3.7-max is flagship and appears in no candidate list.
